ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white regions on the distal lobes. A contiguous low-intensity black region occupies the central area around the notch and the leading edges. Black speckled mottling is observed at the transition zones between the white and black regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated aperture of 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-serrations with varying pixel amplitudes along the entire trailing boundary, with larger, more distinct peaks at the distal ends.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed structure showing broad convexity along the trailing edge of the distal sections, transitioning to a concave profile near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of low-intensity dark spots (mottling or small scars) are visible on the high-intensity white background of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced upward-curving tip on the right fluke lobe.
